title: Promote overflow-safe Li Chao DP partition implementation
alternatives: Quadratic DP per layer rejected by asymptotic constraint.
Signed affine evaluation rejected in favor of squared-distance evaluation to avoid subtraction underflow.
Saturating arithmetic rejected: unreachable u128::MAX DP sentinels were the sole observed overflow and are excluded from the hull.
evidence: cargo test: 4/4 pass, including exact oracle, all-zero/repeated-prefix cases, large values, and 80,000×80 case.
GenOS snapshot/fork/replay and blind-review calls could not create a capsule because this connector reports unknown capsules / unexpected CLI arguments; local evidence retained.
assumptions: TASK constraints bound total prefix sum by 80,000*1,000,000, so all valid squared costs fit u128.
Prefix sums are nondecreasing and may repeat; the discrete Li Chao domain keeps duplicate coordinates.
expected: Exact minimum partition cost in O(groups*n*log n) time and O(n) memory.
observed: All supplied tests pass in debug and release; only src/lib.rs was changed.
